Title: To Live and Die in L.A.
FullTitle: To Live and Die in L.A.
SortTitle: To Live and Die in L.A.
Plot: When his longtime partner on the force is killed, reckless U.S. Secret Service agent Richard Chance vows revenge, setting out to nab dangerous counterfeit artist Eric Masters.
Tagline: A federal agent is dead. A killer is loose. And the City of Angels is about to explode.
